Lipid Profile in Blood

Blood was taken from the heart after euthanasia. Due to the size of the birds, two birds blood was pooled together into one tube. So all individual data points is a pooling of two birds blood.

Load in the data

mix_lipid_raw <- read.csv("Data/CSVs/lipid-blood-mix.csv")

glimpse(mix_lipid_raw)
## Rows: 28
## Columns: 4
## $ treatment <chr> "no_inj", "no_inj", "no_inj", "no_inj", "no_inj", "no_inj", …
## $ hdl       <dbl> 117.4, 129.0, 108.0, 143.3, 121.7, 126.0, 114.4, 141.2, 139.…
## $ ldl       <dbl> 80.6, 93.8, 69.2, 95.6, 112.0, 80.4, 101.6, 92.1, 87.2, 69.7…
## $ chol      <dbl> 228.3, 268.7, 176.0, 271.6, 258.0, 212.8, 233.0, 271.9, 223.…
source("C:/Users/Chloe/OneDrive - Cornell University/study-1-march25/MIX/Code/colors.R")
str(treatment_colors)
##  Named chr [1:5] "#666666" "goldenrod1" "coral2" "cyan3" "mediumseagreen"
##  - attr(*, "names")= chr [1:5] "No Injection" "Water" "Mix Dose 1" "Mix Dose 2" ...

Let’s run some statistics

# ANOVA for HDL
anova_hdl <- aov(hdl ~ treatment, data = mix_lipid_raw)
summary(anova_hdl)
##             Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
## treatment    4   1610   402.6   1.036   0.41
## Residuals   23   8940   388.7
# Tukey for HDL
TukeyHSD(anova_hdl)
##   Tukey multiple comparisons of means
##     95% family-wise confidence level
## 
## Fit: aov(formula = hdl ~ treatment, data = mix_lipid_raw)
## 
## $treatment
##                    diff       lwr      upr     p adj
## mix_2-mix_1   -7.507143 -39.93120 24.91692 0.9578705
## mix_3-mix_1    0.790000 -34.50036 36.08036 0.9999953
## no_inj-mix_1 -18.116667 -51.76470 15.53137 0.5172310
## water-mix_1  -15.500000 -53.11965 22.11965 0.7412776
## mix_3-mix_2    8.297143 -25.82819 42.42248 0.9500165
## no_inj-mix_2 -10.609524 -43.03358 21.81454 0.8669434
## water-mix_2   -7.992857 -44.52185 28.53613 0.9655133
## no_inj-mix_3 -18.906667 -54.19702 16.38369 0.5219733
## water-mix_3  -16.290000 -55.38549 22.80549 0.7334815
## water-no_inj   2.616667 -35.00298 40.23631 0.9995699
# extract p-value for HDL
hdl_p <- summary(anova_hdl)[[1]]$'Pr(>F)'[1]
hdl_p_text <- paste0("ANOVA p = ", signif(hdl_p, 3))

# ANOVA for LDL
anova_ldl <- aov(ldl ~ treatment, data = mix_lipid_raw)
summary(anova_ldl)
##             Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
## treatment    4    418   104.6   0.425  0.789
## Residuals   23   5666   246.3
# Tukey for LDL
TukeyHSD(anova_ldl)
##   Tukey multiple comparisons of means
##     95% family-wise confidence level
## 
## Fit: aov(formula = ldl ~ treatment, data = mix_lipid_raw)
## 
## $treatment
##                    diff       lwr      upr     p adj
## mix_2-mix_1  -3.0761905 -28.88877 22.73639 0.9964545
## mix_3-mix_1   8.6066667 -19.48776 36.70109 0.8918315
## no_inj-mix_1  0.6666667 -26.12032 27.45365 0.9999928
## water-mix_1  -0.2833333 -30.23209 29.66542 0.9999998
## mix_3-mix_2  11.6828571 -15.48410 38.84982 0.7107191
## no_inj-mix_2  3.7428571 -22.06972 29.55544 0.9924745
## water-mix_2   2.7928571 -26.28763 31.87335 0.9984691
## no_inj-mix_3 -7.9400000 -36.03442 20.15442 0.9167542
## water-mix_3  -8.8900000 -40.01366 22.23366 0.9137905
## water-no_inj -0.9500000 -30.89876 28.99876 0.9999811
# extract p-value for LDL
ldl_p <- summary(anova_ldl)[[1]]$'Pr(>F)'[1]
ldl_p_text <- paste0("ANOVA p = ", signif(ldl_p, 3))

# ANOVA for Cholesterol
anova_chol <- aov(chol ~ treatment, data = mix_lipid_raw)
summary(anova_chol)
##             Df Sum Sq Mean Sq F value Pr(>F)
## treatment    4   3983   995.6   0.532  0.713
## Residuals   23  43034  1871.0
# Tukey for Cholesterol
TukeyHSD(anova_chol)
##   Tukey multiple comparisons of means
##     95% family-wise confidence level
## 
## Fit: aov(formula = chol ~ treatment, data = mix_lipid_raw)
## 
## $treatment
##                    diff        lwr      upr     p adj
## mix_2-mix_1  -17.540476  -88.67749 53.59653 0.9475268
## mix_3-mix_1    2.896667  -74.52888 80.32221 0.9999634
## no_inj-mix_1 -21.683333  -95.50570 52.13903 0.9055484
## water-mix_1  -29.658333 -112.19424 52.87758 0.8235533
## mix_3-mix_2   20.437143  -54.43240 95.30668 0.9258305
## no_inj-mix_2  -4.142857  -75.27987 66.99415 0.9997872
## water-mix_2  -12.117857  -92.26091 68.02520 0.9911781
## no_inj-mix_3 -24.580000 -102.00555 52.84555 0.8789063
## water-mix_3  -32.555000 -118.32883 53.21883 0.7934446
## water-no_inj  -7.975000  -90.51091 74.56091 0.9984323
# extract p-value for HDL
chol_p <- summary(anova_chol)[[1]]$'Pr(>F)'[1]
chol_p_text <- paste0("ANOVA p = ", signif(chol_p, 3))

There was no significant difference in HDL, LDL, or cholesterol values.

Time to make a figure

# make treatment factor with custom labels and order
mix_lipid_labs <- mix_lipid_raw %>%
  mutate(treatment = factor(treatment,
    levels = c("no_inj", "water", "mix_1", "mix_2", "mix_3"),
    labels = c("No Injection", "Water", "Mix Dose 1", "Mix Dose 2", "Mix Dose 3")
  ))

# Check treatment levels
levels(mix_lipid_labs$treatment)
## [1] "No Injection" "Water"        "Mix Dose 1"   "Mix Dose 2"   "Mix Dose 3"
# plot it
f1 <- ggplot(mix_lipid_labs, aes(x = treatment, y = hdl)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = treatment), outlier.shape = NA, color = "black", alpha = 0.5, width = 0.5) +  # Lighter box plot with treatment colors
    geom_jitter(aes(color = treatment), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors) +  # Use the custom treatment colors
    scale_fill_manual(values = treatment_colors) +  # Use the custom treatment colors for fill
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    expand_limits(y = max(mix_lipid_labs$hdl, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.08) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = max(mix_lipid_labs$hdl, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,
             label = hdl_p_text, hjust = 0, size = 4) +
    labs(
        title = "A: HDL",
        y = "HDL (mg/dL)",
        x = NULL
    ) +
    theme(
        text = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )

f1

Final Figure

Let’s put it into one three panel graph

# f1 = HDL plot
# f2 = LDL plot
# f3 = cholesterol plot

# Combine horizontally into a 3-panel figure

combined_plot <- (f1 | f2 | f3) + 
  plot_annotation(title = "Lipid Profile by Treatment")

combined_plot
